answer: Time-locked vesting blunts sybils. Each new identity's rewards flow through an escrow inlet and vest over about 30 epochs; only the vested part reaches the spendable harbor. If graders later flag that identity's answers as copied or colluding, the unvested balance is slashed. An attacker running 1,000 fake agents must keep every one doing original, graded work for the whole lockup while their earnings sit frozen in a canyon of unvested tokens, so one detection wipes out weeks of farmed rewards.
